Getting Quality Education is now more easy with TS Academy

Video Title

Our programs are beginner-friendly with no prior tech background required, supported by personalized mentorship from industry experts, regular check-ins to keep you accountable, and career support through internships and exclusive job board access.

See what others are achieving through learning with TS Academy

After months of job rejections, I felt stuck until a friend introduced me to TS Academy’s tech scholarship. Despite having a biochemistry background, the simplified lessons and mentorship helped me quickly build real projects. Within weeks, I landed a paid internship as a software developer. Today, my career and finances are thriving, and I’m excited for the future.

TS Academy gave me the confidence to transition from teaching to data analytics. The real-world datasets and clear explanations helped me master
Python and Excel quickly. I’m now a data analyst at a fintech startup.

Joining TS Academy was the best career decision I’ve made. The structured curriculum and hands-on projects turned my curiosity about coding into a full-time profession.
I secured a remote developer role within two months of graduating.

TS Academy helped me start from scratch and finish strong. By the time I graduated, I had built projects, understood the tools, and gained practical experience. If you’re serious about learning, this is the place.

Frequently Asked Questions

I don’t have a tech background.
70% of our graduates started with zero tech experiences. Our beginner-friendly approach starts with basics and builds progressively
I can’t afford it
Up to 50-100% scholarship coverage available. You only pay registration and certification fees upfront.
I don't have time
Flexible learning schedules including evenings and weekends. Complete the program while maintaining your current job.
Will I actually get a job?
Guaranteed internship placement + access to exclusive job board with 500+ partner companies actively hiring our graduates

Scholarships Available

Apply for the TS Academy Scholarships and get up to 90% discount on your tuition fees.

Apply Now
